title: Current records omit why a decision was made
text: The context-graphs note distinguishes operational objects and their current state from the evidence, policy, exceptions and approvals behind a decision. That distinction exposes missing context in many integrations: two identical-looking outcomes may have been produced under different rules.
qualification: Venture-capital thesis represented in supplied analysis; not evidence that building a graph guarantees better decisions.
